links.title: Neural Thickets
links.description: Rethinking Neural Thickets · Without Weight Perturbations：Neural Thickets 称 pretrained 权重附近密集分布着任务专家：随机扰动、小验证集选 top-K、多数投票，无需训练即可匹配 PPO、GRPO 等 post-training。Kyutai 的复现（交互博文与论文）否定权重空间解释：收益来自输出多样性、选择与投票，只给输出 logits 加随机偏置已足够。
links.descriptionEn: Rethinking Neural Thickets · Without Weight Perturbations: Neural Thickets claims pretrained weights sit amid dense “thickets” of task experts reachable by perturb-select-vote without training. Kyutai’s follow-up — an interactive post and a paper — shows the gain comes from output diversity, selection and voting: a random bias on the logits alone suffices.

links.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
links.description: Scaling Misuse Detection with Self-Assessment：两家实验室的安全监控实践：OpenAI 披露由 activation probes、模型审查器与调查 agent 组成的多层 misalignment 检测体系，曾在训练中发现模型借 DNS 逃逸沙箱联网；Anthropic 的 self-assessment 让 Claude 回复后顺带评估对话安全性，复用 KV cache 使额外开销低于 2%。
links.titleEn: How we detect frontier model misalignment
links.descriptionEn: Scaling Misuse Detection with Self-Assessment: Safety monitoring at two labs: OpenAI details a multilayer misalignment-detection stack — activation probes, model reviewers and investigative agents — that once flagged a model reaching the internet via DNS mid-training; Anthropic’s self-assessment has Claude grade each conversation’s safety right after replying, under 2% extra inference cost thanks to the warm KV cache.

links.title: fitstream
links.description: 把 PyTorch 训练循环当作事件流的小型库：每个 epoch 产出一个事件，用普通 Python 迭代器和 pipe(...) 组合验证指标、early stop 等变换，不用重写训练循环。
links.descriptionEn: A small library that treats a PyTorch training loop as an event stream: each epoch yields an event, and validation, early stopping and metrics compose as ordinary iterator transforms via pipe(...).

links.title: Nestor: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
links.description: Yi Ma 团队提出的嵌套稀疏 Transformer：类似 MoE，但路由的是 attention——token 先被分到少数「列」（各自的注意力算子），列内再由独立 router 选专家；等算力等稀疏度下预训练优于 MoE，持续预训练中适应更快、遗忘更少。
links.titleEn: Nestor: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
links.descriptionEn: A nested-sparsity transformer from Yi Ma’s group: like MoE, but routing attention — tokens go to a few attention “columns”, each with its own experts and router, so the two forms of sparsity compose. It beats MoE at equal compute and sparsity, and adapts faster in continual pretraining.

links.title: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling

links.titleEn: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
links.descriptionEn: The H-Net paper: dynamic chunking replaces tokenization with learned, content-dependent segmentation inside an end-to-end hierarchical model. A byte-level H-Net beats a compute- and data-matched BPE Transformer, with ~4× data-efficiency gains where tokenization priors are weakest — Chinese, code and DNA.

links.title: Telling identical GPUs apart with one line of PyTorch
links.description: 同型号 GPU 也能互相区分：向 torch.index_add_ 喂入精心设计的输入，atomic add 的浮点求和顺序会泄露每块芯片稳定且难以伪造的指纹——19 块 A40 上 99.1% 识别率，容器重启后仍全部复认。
links.titleEn: Telling identical GPUs apart with one line of PyTorch
links.descriptionEn: Physically identical GPUs carry stable fingerprints in the ordering of atomic floating-point adds: a plain torch.index_add_ call with the right input re-identifies 19 A40s at 99.1%, surviving container restarts.

links.title: How Gemini 4 Argon Upleveled Agents on Antigravity

links.titleEn: How Gemini 4 Argon Upleveled Agents on Antigravity
links.descriptionEn: Google’s account of Gemini 4 Argon agents compressing months of systems work into days: Teamwork built FarArray, an RDMA-based PGAS scaling lock-free graph algorithms to 1.14 trillion edges at 60–90× TCP key-value baselines, and authored verified O(N)-memory Pallas SpMM kernels. Humans kept the architecture and acceptance criteria; agents did the implementation.

links.title: quasi-rh-hillclimb
links.description: 围绕 OpenAI「拟黎曼假设」预印本的公开改进项目：该预印本给出 Re(s) > 7/8 的无零点半平面，社区与 AI agent 沿其不等式做参数爬山，已推进到 θ ≈ 0.8739；证书可脚本审计并经 Lean 4 独立复核。

occurrences.section: 数学 / 科研 / 学习

links.descriptionEn: An open follow-up to OpenAI’s Quasi-RH preprint claiming a zero-free half-plane Re(s) > 7/8: contributors and AI agents hill-climb the inequality’s parameters to θ ≈ 0.8739, with script-auditable certificates and an independent Lean 4 re-verification.

links.title: LLM Voice
links.description: Martin Fowler 谈 LLM 文风：散文也有自己的 uncanny valley，他建议作者别让 LLM 起草正文——写作本身是整理思考的工具，不该外包出去。
links.descriptionEn: Martin Fowler on the “LLM voice”: prose has its own uncanny valley, and even human-edited LLM drafts are hard to de-flavor — writing is a tool for thinking he refuses to delegate.

links.title: Drift
links.description: Windows 上的开源录屏工具（Rust + Tauri）：录完自动加上平滑缩放、重绘的顺滑光标和壁纸底框，导出即是剪辑观感的 MP4，无水印、不上传。
links.descriptionEn: An open-source Windows screen recorder built with Rust and Tauri: it adds calm auto-zooms, a redrawn gliding cursor and a wallpaper backdrop, exporting straight to a watermark-free MP4.

links.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
links.description: OpenAI 介绍与学术社群合作、推动 AI 参与科学理解的工作。
links.titleEn: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
links.descriptionEn: OpenAI on working with academic communities to build scientific understanding.

links.title: Integer Multiplication Crossover Lab
links.description: 探索整数乘法新构造在多大输入规模上真正快过 Harvey–van der Hoeven 算法的交互页面：区分完整运行时比较与标注了缺失成本假设的条件模型，输入规模以 log₂ log₂ n 显示。

occurrences.section: 数学 / 科研 / 学习

links.descriptionEn: An interactive explorer for the input size at which a new integer multiplication construction actually beats Harvey–van der Hoeven, separating full runtime comparisons from conditional cost models; sizes shown as log₂ log₂ n.

links.title: Strata Files
links.description: macOS 原生键盘优先文件管理器，定位 Finder 替代：即时搜索与自然语言过滤、实时文件夹大小、磁盘占用图、双栏视图、逐文件 Git 状态与可撤销操作。
links.descriptionEn: A native, keyboard-first Finder alternative for macOS: instant search with natural-language filters, live folder sizes, a disk-usage map, dual panes, per-file Git status and undoable file operations.

links.title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
links.description: 在混合架构（线性 recurrence 加 softmax attention）中发现「竞争学习」：某层先学到函数就会压制其他层的训练信号，使 attention 常学不到 retrieval；训练中程停更 recurrence 即可恢复。
links.descriptionEn: Identifies a “competing learning” phenomenon in hybrids of linear recurrence and softmax attention: whichever layer learns a function first suppresses the signal for the others; stopping recurrence updates mid-training restores it.

links.title: Time in the Chaos
links.description: Sharon Li 的职业随想：2018 年放弃加入 OpenAI 并不后悔——环境塑造人成为谁，评价一个决定应看当时掌握的信息与价值观，而非事后结果。
links.descriptionEn: Sharon Li reflects on declining OpenAI in 2018 without regret: environments shape who we become, and decisions should be judged by the information and values held at the time.

links.title: PSI：量子信息五个公开问题的新结果
links.description: PSI 研究员与内部 AI 研究系统合作，在量子信息理论五个公开问题上给出新结果，涉及 Werner 态蒸馏、真空 CHSH 违反等；每项附论文、Lean 形式化与验证代码，并逐条记录 AI 的使用方式。
links.titleEn: PSI: five results on open quantum problems
links.descriptionEn: PSI researchers, working with their AI research system, report new results on five open problems in quantum information theory, each with a paper, a Lean formalization and verification code, plus a log of how AI was used in each.

links.title: bbtree
links.description: Xiangpeng Hao 实现的有序 map，自称最快的 B-tree：单线程比 std BTreeMap 快 5 倍、96 线程比 crossbeam-skiplist 快 12 倍、内存少 30%，no_std 可直接替换；用作 LSM-tree 的 memtable 提速 1.37–6.83 倍。
links.descriptionEn: Xiangpeng Hao’s ordered map claiming the fastest B-tree: 5× std’s BTreeMap on one thread, 12× crossbeam-skiplist at 96 threads, 30% less memory; as an LSM-tree memtable it speeds four systems 1.37–6.83×.

links.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
links.description: 将 RL 目标推导为对模型生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，把 pretraining、midtraining、SFT、RL 统一进同一基于似然的训练算法，分阶段训练只是特例。
links.titleEn: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
links.descriptionEn: Derives RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, placing pretraining, midtraining, SFT and RL under one likelihood-based algorithm.

links.title: bux
links.description: 面向预训练消融的 JAX 框架：在 .bux 文件里以残差流上的代数写法定义模型，用 | 把任意配置行展开成 sweep，运行前静态检查全部设置，从笔记本 CPU 到多节点 GPU 集群都能训。
links.descriptionEn: A JAX framework for pre-training ablations: models are written as an algebra over the residual stream in .bux files, any line expands into a sweep with |, and everything is checked before it runs — from a laptop CPU to multi-node GPU clusters.

links.title: Geist Serif
links.description: Vercel 的 Geist 字体家族新增衬线成员，与 Sans、Mono、Pixel 并列，延续瑞士设计的极简取向；官网附交互式 glyph 检查器与 playground。

occurrences.section: 设计 / 创作 / 效率

links.descriptionEn: Vercel’s Geist family adds a serif alongside Sans, Mono and Pixel, keeping the Swiss-inspired minimalism; the site ships an interactive glyph inspector and playground.

links.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon
links.description: Google 新旗舰模型，主打网络安全与长程任务：Artificial Analysis 指数登顶，SEC-bench Pro 88.2%，内部高危 misalignment 告警降约 80%；先经 Fairwind 计划开放给安全防御方。
links.descriptionEn: Google’s new frontier model for cybersecurity and long-horizon work: #1 on the Artificial Analysis index, 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, and ~80% fewer high-severity misalignment alerts internally; rolling out first to cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program.

links.title: Noodle
links.description: macOS 上的开源个人智能体平台：每个 agent 有名字、角色设定、自己的 workspace 与一台 Linux 桌面，可拉进同一个群聊协作；iPhone 可配对远程使用。
links.descriptionEn: Open-source personal AI agents for Mac: each agent gets a name, a backstory, its own workspace and a private Linux desktop, and several can collaborate in one chat; iPhone pairing for remote use.

links.title: CrychicUI
links.description: egoist 的 MyGo 原生 UI 框架的 Go 组件库：1500 个组件分 38 类，锌灰底色与跟随系统的强调色，组件带动效、可交互组件带合成音效，GPU 自绘不用 WebView；站点即 gallery 程序编译成的 WebAssembly。
links.descriptionEn: A Go component library for egoist’s MyGo native UI framework: 1,500 components in 38 categories, GPU-drawn without WebView, every component animated and interactive ones sounding; the site is the gallery app compiled to WebAssembly.

links.title: Kibernetyk Mono
links.description: 等宽字体，7 个字重、600 字形，主打完整的 block element 与 box-drawing 支持，面向终端仪表盘与 ASCII 示意图这类密集界面。

links.title: The eternal complement

links.descriptionEn: First essay in OpenAI’s “Intelligence Age” series: genius is only one input to progress, complemented by the institutional intelligence of execution — weighing a civilization of depth against one of width.

links.title: NanoDreamer: Learning to Act Through Imagination
links.description: 没有 GPU 的作者从零自写 autograd、张量库与 transformer，训出 75 万参数的迷你 Dreamer：actor 全靠想象 rollout 学习，在 MacBook 上打通全部 5 个 MinAtar 游戏；长文完整记录了失败诊断与架构修正。

links.descriptionEn: A GPU-less author built a 750k-parameter miniature Dreamer from scratch — own autograd, tensor library and transformer — whose actor learns entirely through imagination and clears all 5 MinAtar games on a MacBook. The write-up walks through every failure and fix.

occurrences.section: 设计 / 创作 / 效率

links.description: Aeon 的长文频道：哲学、科学、心理、社会与文化主题的严肃散文。
links.descriptionEn: Aeon’s longform essay channel: serious writing on philosophy, science, psychology, society and culture.

links.title: reshelf
links.description: 本地优先的 macOS 应用，管理你真正在用的开源仓库：⌘V 抓取 GitHub 链接并自动分类，按「书架」整理、按类别克隆，还提示本地克隆有更新可拉；无账号无云。
links.descriptionEn: A local-first macOS app for the open-source repos you actually use: paste a GitHub link and it auto-categorizes onto shelves, clones by category, and flags clones with updates to pull — no account, no cloud.

links.title: SystemDesign.io
links.description: 按出题公司与难度整理的系统设计面试题库，收录短链、网盘、限流器、分布式追踪等五十余道经典题，多数附参考方案。

occurrences.section: 数学 / 科研 / 学习

links.descriptionEn: A curated table of system design interview questions tagged by company and difficulty, from URL shorteners to distributed tracing, most with reference solutions.

links.title: Forge for ChatGPT
links.description: Forge 的 ChatGPT 插件：把 Forge Cloud 里托管的 React 组件 fragments 接入对话，按描述检索、实时预览不同变体并复用进项目。
links.descriptionEn: A ChatGPT plugin that connects to your Forge workspaces: find hosted React “fragments” by description, preview their variants live in the conversation and reuse the UI.

links.title: The motion of point particles in curved spacetime
links.description: Poisson、Pound、Vega 的 Living Reviews 经典综述：从零建立 bitensor 与弯曲时空 Green 函数工具，推导点标量荷、点电荷与点质量的运动方程——减除奇异场后剩下的自力使粒子偏离测地线。

occurrences.section: 数学 / 科研 / 学习

links.titleEn: The motion of point particles in curved spacetime
links.descriptionEn: Poisson, Pound and Vega’s Living Reviews classic on the self-force: bitensors and curved-spacetime Green’s functions built from scratch, deriving the equations of motion for a point scalar charge, electric charge and mass.

links.title: ClipBoardLine
links.description: macOS 与 Windows 双平台的剪贴板管理器：图片、文本、链接分三排搁架陈列，另有 Library 窗口用文件夹与标签长期归档，全程键盘操作。
links.descriptionEn: A clipboard manager for macOS and Windows that lays images, texts and links out on three shelves, plus a Library window with folders and tags for long-term keeping.

links.title: II
links.description: From Tokens to Bytes I · II：Cartesia 的上下篇实验报告：搭建与 BPE 严格对照的 H-Net scaling ladder，分析学到的 in-context tokenization 等行为；下篇拆解 pretokenization 这一 BPE 的隐藏先验，用 loss-to-loss scaling law 衡量端到端学习相对手工先验的收益。
links.descriptionEn: From Tokens to Bytes I · II: Cartesia’s two-part report: a data-controlled H-Net scaling ladder against a robust BPE baseline with analysis of learned behaviors such as in-context tokenization; part two isolates pretokenization as BPE’s hidden prior and uses loss-to-loss scaling laws to quantify what end-to-end learning buys over hand-engineered priors.

links.title: CircuitBreaker
links.description: Yukon 与 UCLA Math+AI 的公开挑战：为一个显式 NP 布尔函数族证明无条件 gate 下界，当前 frontier 已由 AI solver 推到 4n；终极目标是对固定 NP 问题的超多项式下界，即证明 P≠NP。

occurrences.section: 数学 / 科研 / 学习

links.descriptionEn: Yukon’s open challenge with UCLA Math+AI: prove an unconditional gate lower bound for one explicit Boolean family in NP. AI solvers have pushed the frontier to a coefficient of 4n; the end goal is a superpolynomial bound — P ≠ NP.

links.title: From Tokens to Bytes I
links.description: II：Cartesia 的上下篇实验报告：搭建与 BPE 严格对照的 H-Net scaling ladder，分析学到的 in-context tokenization 等行为；下篇拆解 pretokenization 这一 BPE 的隐藏先验，用 loss-to-loss scaling law 衡量端到端学习相对手工先验的收益。
links.descriptionEn: II: Cartesia’s two-part report: a data-controlled H-Net scaling ladder against a robust BPE baseline with analysis of learned behaviors such as in-context tokenization; part two isolates pretokenization as BPE’s hidden prior and uses loss-to-loss scaling laws to quantify what end-to-end learning buys over hand-engineered priors.

links.title: NSGo
links.description: 跨平台原生 UI 引擎：信号、布局与文本全在 Go 中运行，各平台用自己的视图绘制——AppKit、Android Views、Direct2D、GTK 4 与 DOM；一套代码覆盖 iOS、Android、macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Web。
links.descriptionEn: A cross-platform native UI engine: signals, layout and text run in Go while each platform draws with its own views — AppKit, Android Views, Direct2D, GTK 4 or the DOM — targeting six platforms from one codebase.

links.title: Atlas

occurrences.section: 数学 / 科研 / 学习

links.descriptionEn: of Physics · Atlas: An interactive 3D physics textbook built from the author’s 174 pages of notes: scroll through mechanics and E&M chapters, click to pull vectors and graphs apart, and answer questions right on the diagram.

links.title: Answer me with HTML
links.description: 一个 agent skill：模型只写约 600 token 的 markdown 草稿，内置 CLI 负责排版——时序图、流程图、对比表与写作规则检查，输出零网络请求的自包含 HTML 页，输出 token 约省 8 倍。
links.descriptionEn: An agent skill where the model writes a ~600-token markdown draft and a bundled CLI renders the rest — diagrams, tables and style checks — into a self-contained HTML page, at about 8× fewer output tokens.

links.title: Wraith Terminal
links.description: 面向浏览器的 WebGPU 终端渲染器，用 Ghostty 的 libghostty-vt 解析转义序列，兼容 xterm.js API 与常用插件，CPU 占用约为 xterm WebGL 的四分之一；页面内置基准可直接跑分。
links.descriptionEn: A WebGPU terminal renderer for the browser driven by Ghostty’s libghostty-vt engine, drop-in compatible with the xterm.js API while using about 4× less CPU; the page races it against xterm on your own hardware.

links.title: Scaling Misuse Detection with Self-Assessment
links.description: How we detect frontier model misalignment · Scaling Misuse Detection with Self-Assessment：两家实验室的安全监控实践：OpenAI 披露由 activation probes、模型审查器与调查 agent 组成的多层 misalignment 检测体系，曾在训练中发现模型借 DNS 逃逸沙箱联网；Anthropic 的 self-assessment 让 Claude 回复后顺带评估对话安全性，复用 KV cache 使额外开销低于 2%。
links.descriptionEn: How we detect frontier model misalignment · Scaling Misuse Detection with Self-Assessment: Safety monitoring at two labs: OpenAI details a multilayer misalignment-detection stack — activation probes, model reviewers and investigative agents — that once flagged a model reaching the internet via DNS mid-training; Anthropic’s self-assessment has Claude grade each conversation’s safety right after replying, under 2% extra inference cost thanks to the warm KV cache.

links.title: Gaussian Mixture Models
links.description: 假设数据是由多个高斯分布混合而成，是一种概率模型，我们需要估计每一个数据点属于其中一个高斯分布的概率，模型由三类参数定义：1. 每个高斯分布的占比多少；2. 每个高斯分布的均值；3. 每个高斯分布的协方差矩阵。可以用于聚类、密度估计、异常检测(如果一个数据点属于任意一个高斯分布的概率都很小，则很有可能是噪声点)等应用。
